title: updateFeature (client → server)
description: Facilitator only. Carries the feature `version` it read (mismatch: error STALE_VERSION). Only the properties present are changed; in `criteria` only the keys present are changed and null clears a value. Changing criteria of a feature in an open round gets FEATURE_IN_OPEN_ROUND; title, description and the review mark stay allowed. reviewReason is cleared when markedForReview becomes false.
